record.question: Which of the following signs indicates the need for sputum examination for AFB?
record.explanation: Answer C: Cough for 3 weeks. India’s TB symptom-screening guidance refers people with cough for two weeks or more for diagnostic evaluation, including sputum testing as indicated; among choices, three weeks meets the threshold. Source/context note: Do not wait three weeks if symptoms or risk warrant earlier evaluation; the national screening threshold is generally ≥2 weeks. Reference: https://tbcindia.mohfw.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
